Chapter 813: Chapter 19 What Can You Do To Me? _3

Chapter 813: Chapter 19 What Can You Do to Me? _3

“`

Time is hardly an issue for the Tianzhi True Lord.

Even in dealing with the Taiyin Sovereign next, the Tianzhi True Lord will observe the response of the Taiyang Divine Master from the shadows.

…

Boundless Void.

Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit sits cross-legged just outside a certain world.

...

“Thinking of assembling numerous Perfect Demon True Lords against me?” Lin Yuan had an idea.

If he were unaware of this, facing the union of more than ten Perfect Demon True Lords, Lin Yuan would indeed find it somewhat troublesome.

But since he knew in advance, it became much easier.

“With the current strength of my Spirit Will, I can probably maintain fifty avatars with basic combat power at the same time.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

With Lin Yuan’s strength, producing an avatar was nothing more than a strand of Spirit Will.

However, to have this avatar possess combat power would exert a burden on Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will.

Before undertaking the tenth traversal, Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will barely exceeded one million.

In the Main Universe, at most two or three avatars could maintain basic combat power simultaneously.

Now that Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will exceeds twenty million, the number of avatars capable of maintaining basic combat power has significantly increased.

Avatars are not the same as divided selves; very little Spirit Will is invested, and thus, the mental burden required to maintain basic combat power is significant.

Of course, maintaining basic combat power is relative to Lin Yuan’s True Body Venerable; even his weakest incarnation could easily suppress Tenth Rank and Ninth Rank powerhouses.

Whereas basic combat power referred to demonstrating strength close to the threshold of Tier 11.

Now Lin Yuan occupies a total of forty-two worlds, each with an avatar stationed within, and these avatars, blessed by the Origin Source of the worlds, can fully challenge those Perfect Demon True Lords.

Perfect Demon True Lords, as per the classification of the Main Universe, are basically equivalent to the Fourth and Fifth Layers of Tier 11.

The Perfect Demon True Lords might differ markedly from those Fourth and Fifth Layer powerhouses in the Main Universe in terms of methods and abilities, but overall, they should be on the same level.

Had it not been for the need of these avatars to utilize the Origin Source to barely exhibit the combat power of the Fourth Layer of Tier 11, Lin Yuan, with the power of so many avatars, could have actively encircled and killed those Perfect Demon True Lords.

The Founder of the Void Secret Realm?

Lin Yuan gazed into the depths of the Boundless Void, where his understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule allowed him to vaguely perceive a vast inner world situated at the deepest part of the void.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit wandered in the Void Secret Realm for three to four hundred years without pinpointing the trail of the Realm’s Opener.

This was also why Lin Yuan did not flip the table with those Demonic Divine Masters; even now, without grasping the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm and thus unable to sweep through everything in this Boundless Void at once,

Effortlessly slaying ten or twenty Perfect Demon True Lords would still be no issue.

But such an action carries great risks, as it might force the Opener of the Void Secret Realm to act, which, even if not fatal for Lin Yuan, could affect his three to four hundred years of spreading Martial Dao in the Boundless Void.

Thus, Lin Yuan has been waiting until now, since time is working in his favor anyway.

The longer the delay, the more terrifying the enemies those demons will have to face.

…

“Since those demons are planning to go all out against me, there’s no need for me to be so cautious,” Lin Yuan made up his mind.

In the past three to four hundred years, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit occupied one world after another, trying to stay as low-key as possible to avoid drawing the attention of other demonic gods.

But now, it seems that this approach is not so meaningful; those Perfect Demon True Lords are discussing how to deal with him, so naturally, there is no need to continue as before.

“I can now maintain fifty avatars with basic combat power, so I can fully occupy fifty worlds and then dispatch avatars to preside over them.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted slightly as he looked towards the vast Boundless Void.

Once an avatar takes control of a world, it can swiftly replace the Heavenly Dao with the power of the Demon Tree Seed and gain the blessing of the World Origin Source.

Thus, combat power soars again, reaching the threshold of the Perfect Demon True Lords, and within the world, those Perfect Demon True Lords would not dare to attack recklessly.

Avatar at the threshold of Perfect Demon True Lords is naturally no match for veteran Perfect Demon Lords; at best, they could only challenge them, and they would definitely lose in a real fight.

But within the world, those Perfect Demon True Lords would certainly worry about self-destructive tactics, such as controlling the world’s collapse, the power of which could at the very least gravely wound, if not wholly eradicate, a Perfect Demon at full strength.

Under such circumstances, the Perfect Demon True Lords, if not foolish, would not act rashly.

…

Somewhere at the exit of the Void Secret Realm.

The figures of Tianzhi True Lord and Eastern Wing Lord appeared.

“The matters from here on will be handed over to you,” Tianzhi True Lord said, looking at the Eastern Wing Lord.

Now that the union with other Perfect Demon True Lords has been orchestrated, the rest can be left to the Eastern Wing Lord.

“Held by me?”

“Tianzhi, what do you plan to do?”

The Eastern Wing Lord was slightly startled and quickly asked.

“I have a hunch that the Taiyin Sovereign’s occupation of one world after another, cultivating the ants within as food, is not so simple. And there’s Martial Dao? Such a cultivation system, which greatly diverges from the growth of us demonic beings, can actually allow these ants to grow stronger…”
